title: 국립장애인도서관 이용규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (User Registration, etc.)
(1) A person wishing to use Library materials or facilities shall register as a user through the Library website and be issued a user card.
(2) Matters necessary for user registration and issuance of user cards, other than those prescribed in paragraph (1), shall be determined by the Director.
